# Components and interfaces

The components below implement the approved baseline. Interfaces keep coupling
explicit for consuming teams.

::: {.need #COMP-001 type="component" status="implemented" priority="high" tags="authentication;security"}
## Authentication service

Validates credentials, MFA, and sessions for Aegis IAM channels.
:::

::: {.need #COMP-002 type="component" status="implemented" priority="high" tags="authorization;policy"}
## Policy engine

Evaluates attribute-based policies and returns allow or deny decisions.
:::

::: {.need #COMP-003 type="component" status="implemented" priority="high" tags="lifecycle;provisioning"}
## Lifecycle orchestrator

Consumes people events and performs controlled changes to accounts and groups.
:::

::: {.need #COMP-004 type="component" status="implemented" priority="high" tags="audit;compliance"}
## Audit vault

Stores events with verifiable integrity and controlled query access.
:::

::: {.need #COMP-005 type="component" status="implemented" priority="high" tags="recovery;security"}
## Recovery service

Coordinates identity proofing, approval, and secure issuance of new credentials.
:::

::: {.need #COMP-006 type="component" status="implemented" priority="medium" tags="experience;accessibility"}
## Identity portal

Provides accessible screens for login, consent, and account administration.
:::

::: {.need #IF-001 type="interface" status="implemented" priority="high" tags="integration;oidc"}
## OpenID Connect API

Federation interface for token issuance and metadata discovery.
:::

::: {.need #IF-002 type="interface" status="implemented" priority="medium" tags="integration;scim"}
## SCIM provisioning API

Interface for synchronizing users and groups from source systems.
:::

::: {.need #IF-003 type="interface" status="implemented" priority="high" tags="audit;events"}
## Audit event stream

Signed-event interface delivered to the audit vault and security monitoring.
:::
